name: Total Grid Load Uncertainty Structural Composition
description: Total net grid load uncertainty is structurally composed from demand forecast error and wind power forecast error — two independent uncertainty sources. Structural UPR: total CZ is Minkowski sum of two component CZs.

elements.name: Demand Forecast Error
elements.description: Deviation of actual demand from day-ahead forecast.

uncertainty.source: SMARD: day-ahead demand forecast error for regional control area (smaller than national)

elements.name: Available Balancing Reserve
elements.description: Available primary balancing reserve (MW) — tight FCR band for realistic partial overlap

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σᵢ(δᵢ) = δᵢ for i=demand,wind; CZ_net = CZ_demand ⊕ CZ_wind (Minkowski sum of two independent error CZs)
consistency_relations.upr_description: Structural UPR: total net load uncertainty CZ is Minkowski sum of demand and wind forecast error CZs.
